source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def segments(size, dividers):
        out, start = [], 0
        for d in dividers:
            if start < d:
                out.append((start, d))
            start = d + 1
        if start < size:
            out.append((start, size))
        return out

    rs, cs = segments(h, rows), segments(w, cols)
    cells = [grid[r][c] for a,b in rs for r in range(a,b) for x,y in cs for c in range(x,y)]
    bg = max(set(cells), key=cells.count)
    best = None
    best_count = -1
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(rs):
        for ci,(x,y) in enumerate(cs):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))
            if count > best_count:

    tile = [grid[r][x:y] for r in range(a,b)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri,(u,v) in enumerate(rs):
        for ci,(p,q) in enumerate(cs):
            if (ri,ci) == best:
                continue
            if v-u == len(tile) and q-p == len(tile[0]):
                for dr in range(v-u):
                    out[u+dr][p:q] = tile[dr][:]
    return out

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    vals = [v for row in grid for v in row]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]

    def segments(size, dividers):
        out, start = [], 0
        for d in dividers:
            if start < d:
                out.append((start, d))
            start = d + 1
        if start < size:
            out.append((start, size))
        return out

    rs, cs = segments(h, rows), segments(w, cols)
    best = None
    best_count = -1
    for ri,(a,b) in enumerate(rs):
        for ci,(x,y) in enumerate(cs):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(a,b) for c in range(x,y))
            if count > best_count:
                best, best_count = (ri,ci), count
    sr,sc = best
    a,b = rs[sr]; x,y = cs[sc]
    tile = [grid[r][x:y] for r in range(a,b)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri,(u,v) in enumerate(rs):
        for ci,(p,q) in enumerate(cs):
            if (ri,ci) == best:
                continue
            if v-u == len(tile) and q-p == len(tile[0]):
                for dr in range(v-u):
                    out[u+dr][p:q] = tile[dr][:]
    return out
'''
